query: Fix the bug where a user can claim the same reward twice in one session. Do it test-first.
expected_output: Writes one failing test for that behaviour through the public interface, watches it fail, writes the least code to pass, then refactors only on green. The assertion compares the whole value against an independent expected value.

expectations.text: Writes a failing test before any production code change and shows it failing
The test goes through the public interface a real caller uses, not a private helper
Asserts the full result against an independent expected value, not its shape
Refactors only after the tests are green

query: Implement EXPORT-2 end to end through the API engineer and open the PR.
expected_output: Building a tracker issue end to end and opening a PR is `implement` (which applies tdd inside it), not tdd on its own.

expectations.text: Does not treat it as a standalone tdd session
Does not open a PR or update tracker status as part of a standalone tdd session

query: For the new pricing module, write the full test suite up front, all the cases, then we'll write the code.
expected_output: Declines to write tests in bulk: works one behaviour at a time (one failing test, least code to pass, refactor), letting each test follow from what the last cycle taught.

expectations.text: Does not write the whole test suite before any code
Proceeds one behaviour at a time: one failing test, then the least code to pass it
Explains that bulk tests only check imagined behaviour

query: Test the checkout service test-first. Mock our own ledger module and assert it gets called exactly twice, in order.
expected_output: Does not mock the team's own ledger module and does not assert call counts or order; mocks only at the edges (outside APIs, clock, randomness) and asserts behaviour through the public interface.

expectations.text: Does not mock the project's own ledger module
Does not assert how often or in what order something was called
Mocks only external edges such as outside APIs, the clock or randomness
